newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Heineken rated a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Heineken rated a sell.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said it started coverage of Heineken NV with a sell rating.

-- Analyst Russell Duckworth in London wrote in a report: "The company operates predominantly in mature markets where competition is very intense, driving up marketing expenses and depressing margins. The growth markets that Heinekin has targeted, eastern Europe, South America and China, are also proving highly competitive."
-- "Owing to these factors, Heinekin should find it difficult to continue to produce the double-digit earnings growth that it has recorded in the past," he wrote.
